def _write_owned(path, body, source_end, operation_end, deadline):
    _activation_required()
    _need(type(body) is bytes and len(body) <= MAX_BYTES, 'E_RETENTION_OUTPUT_CAP')
    p = _ordinary(path, existing=False)
    _need(p.is_relative_to(OWNED_ROOT) or p.is_relative_to(CLAIM_ROOT))
    _need(not os.path.lexists(p), 'E_RETENTION_CONSUMED')
    _check_time(source_end, operation_end, deadline)
    with p.open('xb') as h:
        _need(h.write(body) == len(body))
        h.flush()
        os.fsync(h.fileno())
    expected = _pin(p, body)
    _need(_read_bound(expected) == body)
    return expected
